rates.description: Awarded ceiling rates (fully burdened, not-to-exceed hourly prices) on GSA MAS labor categories: one row per labor category per contract and worksite. JSON, pages of 500, at most 10,000 rows (use rates_export for more).

keyword.desc: wildcard search over labor category, vendor and contract number (2+ characters): 'data scientist'

search.desc: exact, case-sensitive match field:value: 'labor_category:Data Scientist', 'vendor_name:BOOZ ALLEN HAMILTON INC', 'idv_piid:47QREA22D000R'

education_level.desc: filter: HS, AA, BA, MA, PHD (upper case); several with |: BA|MA

price_range.desc: filter: min,max dollars per hour, e.g. 50,150

worksite.desc: filter: customer, contractor or virtual (lower case; the pack lowercases)

business_size.desc: filter: S (small) or O (other than small)

sin.desc: filter: GSA Special Item Number, e.g. 54151S

category.desc: filter: e.g. Information Technology, Professional Services

filter.desc: raw filters as a list of field:value strings (sent as repeated filter=)

ordering.desc: sort field: current_price (default), labor_category, vendor_name, education_level, min_years_experience

exclude.desc: record ids to leave out, separated by |

rates_export.description: The same search as one CSV export (export=y): every matching row, no 10,000 cap (55,000+ rows for 'engineer'); columns renamed to the rates names.

rate_stats.description: Summary of current_price over every matching rate (all matches, not only 10,000): count, min, max, mean, standard deviation, percentiles 10-90. One row.

rate_facets.description: Counts of matching rates by education level, worksite, business size, security clearance, minimum years of experience and labor category (top 500): rows facet, key, doc_count.

suggest_labor_category.description: Labor category titles containing a text (suggest-contains), with counts: the exact spellings for search=labor_category:...

suggest_vendor_name.description: Vendor names containing a text, with counts.

suggest_contract.description: Contract numbers (IDV PIID) containing a text, with counts.
